verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents a broad programmatic surface. It has an HTTP query API usable locally and on Cloud, an OpenAPI spec, an MCP endpoint covering query, observability and customer administration, and CLI commands to create and list databases, projects and clusters. However, no document claims API–UI parity, and API tokens are explicitly managed through the Helix dashboard, so at least one UI function lacks a documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a programmatic API for token and key management, and independent confirmation that all dashboard actions are API-accessible.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The HelixDB HTTP API accepts operation-tree queries at `POST /v2/query`. The same contract is available from a local server and a Helix Cloud gateway.
Query, observability, and customer administration tools share this endpoint.
Tokens are managed through the Helix dashboard.
